collection.description: The Siloam inscription (late 8th century BCE) from the water tunnel under the City of David, which tells how the miners met in the rock: Driver's 1913 text and translation with photographs of the stone in Istanbul.

texts.title: Siloam inscription (Hezekiah's tunnel), Istanbul 2195 T
texts.source: Istanbul Archaeology Museums 2195 T, photographs on Wikimedia Commons (CC0) + S. R. Driver's 1913 text and translation (public domain)
texts.description: The Siloam inscription from Hezekiah's tunnel in Jerusalem (late 8th century BCE), six lines on the meeting of the two tunnelling teams, with Driver's 1913 Hebrew text and translation and photographs of the stone.

authors.name: Scribe of Hezekiah's tunnel
authors.bio: The unnamed writer of the inscription cut into the wall of the Siloam water tunnel in Jerusalem.
